                                    8418          MACRO                                                          00050038
                                    8419          IDACBOPT &OPTCD=,&AM=,&MF=,&CALLER=                            00100038
                                    8420 .* FUNCTION -  THIS MACRO PROCESSES THE RPL KEYWORD OPTCD. IT IS CALLED 00110038
                                    8421 .*             BY IDACBRPL.  IT VALIDITY CHECKS THE OPTIONS SPECIFIED   00120038
                                    8422 .*             BY THE USER ON GENCB, MODCB, OR TESTCB FOR OPTCD. IT     00130038
                                    8423 .*             CHECKS FOR MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OPTIONS SPECIFIED AND      00140038
                                    8424 .*             ISSUES ERROR MESSAGES VIA IDAERMAC.  IF THE OPTIONS ARE  00142038
                                    8425 .*             VALID, IDACBOPT SETS VALUES IN VARIOUS GLOBAL ARRAYS     00144038
                                    8426 .*             TO BE USED BY IDACB2 TO BUILD A PARAMETER LIST OF        00146038
                                    8427 .*             ARGUMENT CONTROL ENTRIES FOR THE CONTROL BLOCK           00148038
                                    8428 .*             MANIPULATION MODULE TO BE USED AT EXECUTE TIME.          00148438
                                    8429 .*             IT CALLS IDACB3 TO SET THE ELEMENT TYPE CODE AND THE     00148838
                                    8430 .*             KEYWORD TYPE CODE FOR OPTCD.                             00149238
                                    8431 .*                                                                      00149638
                                    8432 .*             IT IS ALSO CALLED BY THE RPL DECLARATIVE MACRO VIA       00149738
                                    8433 .*             IDACBRPL. WHEN CALLED BY THE DECLARATIVE MACRO,          00149838
                                    8434 .*             DIFFERENT GLOBALS ARE SET THAN THASE USED BY THE CBMM.   00149938
                                    8435 .*             THEREFORE, THE BITS SET IN THESE GLOBALS MUST BE         00166638
                                    8436 .*             IDENTICAL TO THE WAY THEY WILL APPEAR WHEN THE           00176638
                                    8437 .*             CONTROL BLOCK IS GENERATED.                              00178638
                                    8438 .*                                                                      00180638
                                    8439 .*                                                                      00181100
                                    8440 .*                                                                      00181300
                                    8441 .*  CHANGE ACTIVITY                                                     00181500
